title: Gravitational Changes
text:
Walkthrough

The first thing you have to do is jump on the elevator, and climb down. This will trigger a turret that shoots down a box, which you will need to block turret fire.

To continue, you need two boxes, one of which is to the left. Lower the elevator and move the crate onto the top of the elevator. Raise the elevator, and climb it. Use the box to jump over the turret and into an large alcove. In this alcove, you will then use the anti-gravity console. You have to turn it on to move a box to the top-left, turn it off to have it fall and start sliding, and turn it back on to have it launch over the barrier. After that, push the crate to the right.

Finally, head to the right, using the first box as cover, then climb the ladder, and reverse gravity. Move both boxes above the moving platform area - one above the platform, and one in front of it. Reset gravity to normal, and use the boxes to climb and reach the ladder.
